item.title: Academic Point
item.description: 👩‍💻 Source Code This project is about Student Information System using Python and here we have chosen SQLite for storing information in a SQL database. In this console application, there are three section which is Student Panel, Teacher Panel and Admin Panel. Here we focused on our SQL database.
